senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. אֲרִי I)to permeate, penetrate; to shoot forth.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 43a">Nidd. 43ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chagigah 15a">Ḥag. 15ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>כל … שאינו יוֹרֶה כחץ אינה מזרעת</he> (Ms. M. <he>אינו מוליד</he>; Ms. M. 2 <he>שאינה יוֹרָה</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) a spermatic emission which does not permeate (shoot forth) like an arrow, cannot fructify; <cite ref="Yevamot 65a:6">Yeb. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>היא קיימא לה בי׳ כחץ</he> she can feel it whether the emission is permeating &c.

Sifré Deut. 42 יוֹרֶה שמתכון … יורד וכ׳ the rain is called yoreh (shooting), for it is aimed at the earth with deliberation, and does not come down in a storm; Taan. 6ᵃ יורה שיורד בנחת.—2) to throw, shoot.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133">Yalk. Gen. 133</cite> <he>לִירוֹת בב׳ ידיו</he> to throw spears with both hands; v. infra.

senses.gloss: to permeate. Sifré l. c. שמוֹרֶה ומרוה הארץ וכ׳ for it (the yoreh, v. supra) pervades and satisfies the earth and gives her drink down to the deep (Taan. l. c., Yalk. Deut. 863 only שמַרְוֶה).—[Y. Maasr. I, 49ᵃ top משיורו וכ׳, read: משיִרְווּ, v. רָוָה a. מַרְוִית.]

units: Lam. R. to I, 18 שלש … הוֹרוּ בו three hundred arrows did they shoot into his body; Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵃ bot. יורו במשיח וכ׳ (read: הורו or יָירוּ, Kal). Yalk. Gen. l. c. (fr. Midr. Vayisu) היה מוֹרֶה חניתית וכ׳ he threw spears with both hands &c.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 3:15">Ex. R. s. 3</cite> (ref. to <he>והיריתיך</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 4:12">Ex. IV, 12</cite>) <he>מורה אני וכ׳</he> I shall shoot my words into thy mouth like an arrow; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to point out, to direct, teach, instruct; to decide.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 1:1">Hor. I, 1</cite> <he>הוֹרוּ ב״ד וכ׳</he> if a court has (through error) directed to transgress one of the commands &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Horayot 1:2">Ib. 2</cite> <he>ה׳ ב״ד וידעו וכ׳</he> if a court has given a decision and finding out its mistake reversed it.
<cite ref="Mishnah Yevamot 10:2">Yeb. X, 2</cite> <he>הוֹרוּהָ ב״ד לינשא</he> if a court instructed her that she may marry again.
<cite ref="Berakhot 31b">Ber. 31ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Eruvin 63a:20">Erub. 63ᵃ</cite> <he>כל המוֹרֶה הלכה בפני וכ׳</he> whoever decides a law-point in the presence of his teacher.
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:8">Ab. V, 8</cite> <he>המוֹרִים בתורה וכ׳</he> who decide in religious matters against the law (by means of sophistry).

<cite ref="Shabbat 19b">Sabb. 19ᵇ</cite> <he>ה׳</he> … <he>כר׳ וכ׳</he> R. … decided in agreement with the opinion of &c.; a. fr. [<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:10">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> (a citation, from Sirach X, 26?; v., however, Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) <he>בצר אל יוֹרֶה</he> he who is in trouble, should give no opinion—applied by analogy to prayer in an unsettled condition of mind.]
